title: FrustenStein Elektro
description: A lightweight, vanilla-friendly modpack made for friends and coworkers. Focused on performance, stability, and quality-of-life improvements without changing core gameplay.
body:
🧱 Frustenstein Electrical – Simple, Stable & Made for Playing Together

This modpack was created specifically for playing together with friends and coworkers.

It is designed to improve performance, stability, and usability, while keeping the core vanilla gameplay completely unchanged.

The modpack does not add new dimensions, items, mobs, or progression systems. Instead, it focuses on making Minecraft run smoother, feel more responsive, and be easier to use, especially in multiplayer environments.

⚡ Performance & Stability

The modpack includes a carefully selected set of performance and optimization mods to improve FPS, reduce memory usage, and stabilize gameplay on both client and server:

  • Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore for rendering, simulation, and memory optimization
  • Concurrent Chunk Management Engine for more reliable chunk loading
  • EntityCulling & More Culling to reduce unnecessary rendering
  • Fast IP Ping for faster multiplayer server list loading

These changes improve performance without altering gameplay mechanics.

👀 Quality of Life & User Interface

Several utility and interface mods are included to improve clarity and usability:

  • Jade for block and entity information
  • Xaero’s Minimap & World Map for in-game navigation
  • Roughly Enough Items (REI) for recipe viewing
  • BetterF3 for a cleaner debug screen
  • AppleSkin for detailed hunger information
  • Mouse Tweaks & Chat Heads for improved interaction and communication
  • Lighty to help detect dark spawnable areas
  • Open Parties and Claims for simple group and land management on servers

All features are optional, configurable, and designed to remain vanilla-friendly.

🎨 Visual Improvements (Optional)

The modpack includes light visual enhancements that do not change gameplay:

  • Iris for optional shader support
  • Continuity for connected textures
  • Falling Leaves & Wakes for subtle environmental effects
  • NotEnoughAnimations for smoother player animations
  • Entity Texture & Model Features for improved mob rendering
  • Euphoria Patcher for better compatibility with shaders and visual mods

Shaders and visual effects are optional and can be disabled.

🧩 Technical Base & Compatibility

  • Built on Fabric with Fabric API
  • Uses Architectury, Balm, and Cloth Config for compatibility and configuration
  • Includes Mod Menu, Sodium Extra, and Reese’s Sodium Options for easy setup
  • Supports Placeholder API for server-side integration

The modpack is designed to require minimal maintenance and remain stable across long multiplayer playthroughs.

✅ Intended Use

  • Friends and coworkers
  • Private multiplayer servers and LAN worlds
  • Players who want better performance and usability without changing vanilla mechanics

Note: While the project name is German, this modpack is intended for an international audience and is fully documented in English.
